import re

# The regex for type 'x'
pattern = r'(0[xX])?[0-9a-fA-F]+'
match = re.match(pattern, '0B1')
print(f'Match: {match.group() if match else None}')

# What int_convert does with base=16 and string='0B1'
string = '0B1'
base = 16
chars = '0123456789abcdef'
filtered = re.sub('[^%s]' % chars, '', string.lower())
print(f'Filtered: {repr(filtered)}')
print(f'int({repr(filtered)}, {base}) = {int(filtered, base)}')
"
